description: Wire `ManualReviewTTL` (already present on `LifecycleConfig`, env var `WORKSPACE_SANDBOX_MANUAL_REVIEW_TTL`) into `LifecycleReconciler.ReconcileLifecycle` so abandoned `manualReview=true` sandboxes are auto-denied on TTL expiry instead of leaking indefinitely. Clock-injected TTL expiry test required. Self-contained; can land in parallel with or after Phase 3.
name: workspace-sandbox-manual-review-ttl-gc
title: Implement manualReview TTL GC in LifecycleReconciler (Phase 4)
